'''2007 Texas State Championship JW Millet DS Hoth: Defensive Perimeter''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[JW Millet]] at [[2007 Texas State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Name on sheet:''' J.W. Millet III
* '''Deck name:''' Tanks are broken!
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
